scope: current 0–60 development; frozen62.33766 baseline; same-key50ms fixed .9995/.14; no reference event editing
sources: verified original Demucs bass + cached raw pYIN/CREPE/PENN; no new inference or separation

audio_features.flux_normalizer: median peak strength across frozen candidate onsets

stage1.rule: merge only adjacent same-pitch notes gap<=80ms, if BOTH amplitude rise and normalized local flux are below thresholds; never across another pitch or long rest

stage2.fixed: winning whole stage1 recipe; retain baseline if no net improvement
stage2.candidates: consecutive rounded pitch evidence>=80ms with energy and independent model consensus; peak anchor within [-256,+32]ms of run start; existing onset exclusion80ms; no insertion inside existing same-pitch duration; clip to next note and preserve monophony

profiles.agreement: pYIN>=.05 + either CREPE>=.21 or PENN>=.2 same rounded pitch
pYIN>=.05 + both CREPE>=.21 and PENN>=.2 same rounded pitch
CREPE>=.21 and PENN>=.2 same rounded pitch even without pYIN

stage3.harmonic_score: Hann-window FFT8192 over audio within note (up to320ms), sum five harmonic band maxima/k; compare pitch and +/-12 only

retime.criterion: local independent RMS-rise peak salience >=1.5 current rise and amplitude rise>=1.1; preserve adjacent spacing>=80ms; no constant shift

selection: maximum formal onset F1; ties fewer FP; preserve previous best on equal/lower F1; no post-score parameter expansion
outputs: audio evidence and every edit reason, stepwise MIDI/FP/FN/gain-loss, selected bass and only-bass-replaced six-track, MIDI-only WAV
limits: CPU2; no API/training/new model forward; original media and five other tracks untouched; automatic acoustic analysis is not human listening

implementation_clarifications_before_sco.addition_anchor: union RMS-rise onset_detect and frozen short-flux backtracked onsets; require rise>=1.1 OR flux>=.5; nearest to run start, ties earlier
implementation_clarifications_before_sco.octave_support: cumulative accepted neural frames within first320ms of note,64ms; highest spectral score wins
implementation_clarifications_before_sco.retime: anchors from same union; salience positive log-RMS derivative maximum within+-8ms; nearest eligible peak wins, ties stronger then earlier; truncate previous overlap
implementation_clarifications_before_sco.energy_gate: original 256ms RMS >= max(.001,peak*.025) for all addition runs
implementation_clarifications_before_sco.candidate_count: 12 IDs; identical bytes possible for conservative no-op profiles; report dedup hashes
